tools.name: doctor_search
tools.description: Find US clinicians or healthcare organizations by name, specialty, city, state, ZIP code, or within a radius of a ZIP code. Returns NPI registry records.

tools.name: doctor_npi_lookup
tools.description: Return the NPI registry record for one 10-digit National Provider Identifier: names, credentials, taxonomy, practice and mailing addresses, status.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "doctor_npi_lookup" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Return the NPI registry record for one 10-digit National Provider Identifier: names, credentials, taxonomy, practice and mailing addresses, status.
